text:
maria: Quick FYI — reproducible packaging problem with Poetry editable installs for the Python SDK. Steps: `poetry install` in sampleapp, then `python -c \"import redwood_sdk; import redwood_sdk.asyncio\"` -> ModuleNotFoundError for redwood_sdk.asyncio. Wheel builds in CI look normal.

sam: That sounds like PEP 660/editable backend oddness. Poetry used pip's editable wheel builder; if package metadata doesn't explicitly include subpackages some backends drop them. Can you paste pyproject.toml?

maria: Minimal snippet: ```toml
[tool.poetry]
name = "redwood-sdk"
version = "0.0.0"
packages = [ { include = "redwood_sdk" } ]
[tool.poetry.dependencies]
python = "^3.8"
```
We have `redwood_sdk/__init__.py` and subpackages `asyncio/` and `typing/`. `pip wheel .` contains subpackages; `poetry install` editable sometimes only installs the root file. Varies across machines.

josh: Two things: 1) confirm you're not using implicit namespace packages; 2) check Poetry version (`poetry self show` / `poetry self update`) — older versions had editable regressions.

maria: Not using namespace packages. All subdirs have __init__.py.

sam: Run `python -c \"import redwood_sdk, pkgutil; print(list(pkgutil.walk_packages(redwood_sdk.__path__)))\"` in both environments and `pip show -f redwood-sdk`. That will show what's installed.

maria: In poetry env pkgutil shows only `redwood_sdk` root; `pip show -f` lists only `redwood_sdk/__init__.py`. `pip install -e .` works and shows full tree.

dev-bot: CI job #7120 failed on macos-arm with "Invalid wheel tag for platform" — separate but flagged: https://ci.example/7120

josh: Practical fix: make packaging metadata explicit. Use the table form:```toml
[tool.poetry.packages]
include = "redwood_sdk"
```
And ensure `py.typed` is included via `include = ["py.typed"]` so types and packaging aren't pruned. Also recommend `poetry self update`.

katie: Short-term contributor workarounds: `pip install -e .` or `poetry build && pip install dist/*.whl`. Long-term we should add a CI smoke test that runs `poetry install` and attempts `import redwood_sdk.asyncio`.

maria: Opening a tiny PR to update pyproject with explicit packages + include py.typed, and adding a doc note about editable quirks. Will link PR soon.

sam: Prefer explicit `[tool.poetry.packages]` table — behavior varied across poetry versions with inline `packages` attr. Good call on CI smoke test.

josh: Also track the macOS ARM wheel-tag CI failure separately (not the same symptom).

katie: I'll add the doc and a CI job in a follow-up. :thumbsup:

maria: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-py/pull/1345 — includes explicit `tool.poetry.packages` and `py.typed` include. Please review.

josh: Reviewing now. Thanks for clear repro and fix plan. If any contributors still see missing subpackages after merge, collect minimal repro details and we'll create a minimal sample repo to reproduce.

maria: Thanks all, closing for now. If it reappears I'll post more details.
